sketches.mechanism: Orphan rule — you cannot implement a trait for a type unless you own either the trait or the type
sketches.resonance: The compiler enforces that you cannot teach something to love you if neither love nor you belongs to your world.

sketches.mechanism: Optionals and nil-coalescing — a value that might not exist collapses to a default only when forced
sketches.resonance: Memory is optional; when it finally becomes nil, the fallback is silence.
sketches.draft:
let memory: String? = nil
let what_remains = memory ?? _

sketches.mechanism: NULL != NULL evaluates to unknown, not true — nothing is not even equal to itself
sketches.resonance: Two absences placed side by side still cannot recognize each other.
sketches.draft:
SELECT *
FROM missing a
JOIN missing b
  ON a.name = b.name
WHERE NULL = NULL
-- returns nothing
-- even emptiness fails to meet itself
